CustomField.description: TNCI-139 / ELV-CPQ-036. Deterministic CPQ-faithful Day 1 ARR formula. Returns ELV_ARR_Amount__c when the line is not excluded and spans the maintained line-local Day 1 start-date stamp; otherwise 0. No cross-object references; eligible as a Quote roll-up source.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT( ELV_Exclude_from_ARR__c ), NOT( ISBLANK( ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date_Stamp__c ) ), NOT( ISBLANK( Ruby__SubscriptionStartDate__c ) ), Ruby__SubscriptionStartDate__c <= ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date_Stamp__c, IF( NOT( ISBLANK( ELV_Effective_End_Date__c ) ), ELV_Effective_End_Date__c, Ruby__SubscriptionEndDate__c ) >= ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date_Stamp__c ), ELV_ARR_Amount__c, 0 )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Annualized ARR contributed by this line on the Quote Day 1 ARR start date.
CustomField.label: Day 1 ARR
